item.title: [−1] Yen Slumps as Fed Rate-Hike Bets Boost Dollar
item.description:
Signal: tighter US monetary policy (US). 10 reports from WSJ, Traders Union, The Conference Board and 7 more. Related: “Fed’s Collins Says ‘Steady, Gradual’ Rate Hikes Appropriate”. Ongoing: also reported on 3 of the previous 7 days (first 12 Nov).

Real estate: mild headwind (−1) — Funding costs rise

Why it matters: Higher US rates and yields pull foreign money out of emerging markets, weaken the rupee and push up Indian bond yields.

Market gauges: Foreign investor flows −3, Rupee −1, Bond market (G-Secs) −1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [−1] India's Retail Inflation Rises to 6.09% in October 2026; Food Inflation Surges to 8.94%
item.description:
Signal: firmer Indian inflation (India). 2 reports from Dairy News Today, Dalal Street Investment Journal. Related: “India’s milk inflation exceeds 4%; paneer prices rise more than 5.5%”. Turn: earlier readings (14 Nov) pointed the other way.

Real estate: mild headwind (−1) — Rate cuts pushed back

Why it matters: Faster price growth erodes household budgets and makes RBI rate cuts less likely or hikes more likely, lifting bond yields.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −3, Bond market (G-Secs) −1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
